Scampi, TK, 3 Zehe/n Knoblauchzehe(n), gehackt, 1 große Zwiebel(n), geachtelt, 3 Handvoll Bohnen, grüne TK, 2 Paprikaschote(n), rot und gelb, 1/2 Brokkoli, davon die Röschen, 200 ml Kokosmilch, 200 ml Geflügelbrühe, 1 EL Fischsauce, 3 EL Sojasauce, hell, 1 TL, gehäuft Kurkuma, etwas Chilipulver, 1 EL Currypulver Thai-), 2 EL Erdnussbutter, crunchy, etwas Speisestärke, 2 Möhre(n), etwas Öl.
Following Thai culinary tradition, what ingredients make up World's Best Mussels! Steamed in a Thai Curry-White Wine Sauce?<image>

You will require these ingredients: 1/2 to 3/4 lb. fresh mussels, or 1 pack frozen mussels (I buy frozen organic) - keep frozen until ready to cook, 3-4 cloves garlic, minced, 1/3 cup finely chopped shallots or purple onion, 1 thumb-size piece galangal OR ginger, optional: 1 fresh red chili, minced, 1 cup white wine, 1 cup good-tasting chicken stock, 1/2 tsp. turmeric, 1 tsp. ground coriander, 1 tsp. fish sauce, plus more to taste, 1/3 can coconut milk (not 'lite'), 1 fresh lime, 1-2 chopped loose cups fresh coriander/cilantro (chop just before serving), 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil.
Which ingredients should I gather to create this Thai-style meal: Würziger Rindfleischsalat nach Thai - Art?<image>

The essential ingredients include: 550 g Rindfleisch (Rinderhüfte), 3 EL Sojasauce, 2 EL Fischsauce, 2 EL Zucker, braun, 3 Zehe/n Knoblauch, fein gehackt, 1 EL Ingwer, frisch, fein gehackt, Für die Sauce:, 3 Zehe/n Knoblauch, 6 Chilischote(n), z.B. Jalapenos, je nach Schärfegrat mit und ohne Kerne oder weniger, 4 1/2 EL Zucker, braun, 3 EL Fischsauce, 3 EL Zitronensaft, frisch gepresst, Für den Salat:, 1 Kopf Salat, die ganzen geputzten Blätter verwenden, 1 Salatgurke(n), geschält und in dünne Scheiben geschnitten, 12 Kirschtomate(n), halbiert, ersatzweise 3 Flaschentomaten in Scheiben geschnitten, 12 Blätter Pfefferminze, (nach Belieben), 1 kleine Zwiebel(n), rot, in dünne Scheiben geschnitten, 4 g Koriandergrün, 40 g Erdnüsse, geröstet, grob gehackt.
If I want to cook this dish according to Thai culinary customs, what ingredients are necessary: Yum Jin Gai (Spicy Northern Thai-Style Chicken Soup)?<image>

The key ingredients are: 1 whole small chicken (about 2 1/2 pounds), legs and breasts removed, carcass reserved, 2 small dried hot chilies, 1/4 teaspoon whole coriander seed, 1/4 teaspoon whole Sichuan peppercorns, 1 whole long pepper (see note above), 1/4 teaspoon whole cloves, 1 star anise pod, 1 (1/4-inch piece) mace, or 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg, 1 (1/4-inch piece) mace, or 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg, 1 (1/4-inch piece) mace, or 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg, 1/2 a cinnamon stick, 4 pods black cardamom, inner seeds only, or 1 pod green cardamom, 4 pods black cardamom, inner seeds only, or 1 pod green cardamom, 1/4 teaspoon whole black peppercorns, 1 tablespoon Thai shrimp paste, 3 thin slices galangal (or ginger if galangal is not available), 1 stalk lemongrass, bottom 4 inches only, bruised multiple times with the dull side of a knife blade, 2 whole shallots, thinly sliced, 1 tablespoon vegetable or canola oil, 4 ounces button mushrooms, cut into quarters, 1/4 cup roughly chopped cilantro, Fish sauce, Kosher salt.
